ideas.label: Vancura Position
ideas.principle: Attack the rook pawn laterally instead of waiting passively behind it.
ideas.summary: A rook can often draw against a rook pawn by attacking it from the side while the king remains near the opposite wing. Side activity prevents the stronger king from finding shelter.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]

ideas.label: Vancura Position
ideas.principle: Combine lateral pawn attacks with flank checks.
ideas.summary: The Vancura defense works against a rook pawn on the sixth rank when the stronger rook protects it from behind. Keep the defending rook active from the side and check as soon as the king approaches the pawn.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]

ideas.label: Vancura Position
ideas.principle: Maintain side distance and preserve the switch to rear checks.
ideas.summary: In the Vancura position, place the rook far enough along the fourth rank to attack the pawn laterally without being chased by the king. Keep the defending king away from mating nets and switch to rear checks if the pawn advances.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]
